messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need a single-run checklist for the marketplace listing + HW partner certification + SI dry-run before we sign the public blog. Can folks confirm final cutover windows and asset owners?
ajay: I can own SKU mapping and partner billing notes. Will need partner-provided SKUs by Tue (PST).
kelsey: Embargo question — do we still aim for 4/10? marketing needs final copy + hero assets by 4/3.
sam: Staging capacity: reserving a 3hr slot on 4/6 09:00-12:00 PT for tenant provisioning + e2e smoke with partner images. Deploy-bot: staging-slot-booked #staging A/C 1759 reserved by sam for 2024-04-06T09:00:00-07:00 to 2024-04-06T12:00:00-07:00.
shreyas: SI dry-run note: we'll need a seeded tenant with sample data and a sample L3 config (auth + VPC routing). Please share a template. I can spin up adapters if we get creds.
maria: @shreyas adding the template link here: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-template (placeholder) — please copy and replace with partner values.
todd: Legal flag: logo + trademark approvals must be signed off by partner legal by 4/1 latest. Otherwise we push embargo. I'll ping partner counsel today.
kelsey: Also need SEO meta and 3 localized hero lines for EU/JP. Can product help with copy variants?
ajay: Product: if you can confirm character limits, I'll slot localizations. Otherwise I can default to short/medium/long variants.
sam: For HW cert: firmware image hash and a quick test matrix (power/perf/thermal) required. Partners should run cert harness, but we need results file by 4/2. I'll share the harness command: ```./cert-harness --device <id> --report out.json```
shreyas: We'll run one end-to-end with partner SI on 4/6 during staging. If they pass, we can signal green for canary on 4/8.
kelsey: Marketing asks: can we get a co-author list for the blog by 3/29? Need byline order and any partner quotes.
maria: Action items summary: 1) Partner SKUs -> ajay (due 3/26). 2) Logo/trademark signoff -> todd (3/31). 3) Hero + localized copy -> kelsey + product (3/29). 4) Cert harness results -> sam (4/2). 5) Staging dry-run -> shreyas/sam (4/6). 6) Embargo date tentative 4/10 pending signoffs. Everyone react with :thumbsup: if aligned or call out blockers.
ajay: :thumbsup: assigning internal billing ticket.
kelsey: :thumbsup: will chase localizers.
sam: :thumbsup: sharing harness and staging playbook in #eng-infra.
shreyas: blocker — partner AAD SSO needs client_id; partner engineering, pls share by EOD.
todd: noted, will escalate with partner counsel.
maria: Great — I'll compile a one-pager and send to partners after lunch. If anything changes, post updates here.
deploy-bot: reminder: dry-run checklist draft uploaded: https://our-company.docs/dry-run-checklist (editable)
maria: Thanks all — closing this thread for now, will reopen if we hit a blocker.
